verdict.rationale: SavvyCal ships an official Zapier app that it markets for no-code automations including CRM sync and creating or updating CRM records. It also has registrable, HMAC-signed webhooks with an event.created trigger and retries, plus a REST API for listing events, so bookings can flow into an automation stack without manual copying. Missing for 10: native Salesforce and HubSpot integrations (CRM sync is only evidenced via Zapier, webhooks or the API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
